value.rationale: The Weeks manifold is the canonical smallest-volume closed orientable hyperbolic three-manifold, while its first homology has \(24\) nonzero order-five classes. The theorem shows that every one of those classes already occurs at the absolute minimum simple-cycle length and completely enumerates the \(377\)-carrier shell. This is a natural finite systolic invariant of a canonical triangulation, not a recomputation of the known homology group.
